messages:
maria_support: FYI customer Anna from Acme reported a 3x spike on their March invoice, they say it lines up with a bulk export job that hit timeouts and retried.
kevin_billing: Can you paste the invoice lines / request IDs?
maria_support: pasted the ledger IDs in thread: ledger_ids=[L-8742,L-8743,L-8744] and customer claim: 'we retried large batch after 504, then saw surging token counts'
anna_acme: confirmed — our client retried when we saw 504s. we didn't set Idempotency-Key on the batch requests.
jana_eng: quick question — were retries coming from client or our edge? any gateway logs?
maria_support: attaching logs from src (excerpt):
```
[2026-12-01T08:12:03Z] request_id=req_01 status=504 latency_ms=15002 route=/v1/generate
[2026-12-01T08:12:05Z] request_id=req_02 status=200 latency_ms=320 route=/v1/generate
headers: x-client-id=acme, x-retry-count=1
```
ingress-bot: Possible replay detected: same payload hash seen at 2026-12-01T08:12:03 and 2026-12-01T08:12:05 but different request_id. No Idempotency-Key header present.
kevin_billing: I queried the usage ledger: SELECT sum(tokens) FROM usage WHERE ledger_id in ('L-8742','L-8743','L-8744'); result=120_450 tokens. But invoice showed 360_900 tokens — looks like triple-counting.
jana_eng: interesting — triple equals exactly the retry count? maybe gateway retried 3x at L7 timeout backoff. Need request timing correlation.
sre-bot: autocollect: ingress autoscale triggered 08:12:02, multiple retries logged in proxy: upstream retries=2 per connection.
maria_support: Customer says client retried only once but they observed x3 billing.
kevin_billing: Could be double accounting: client retries produced separate ledgers + gateway replay + replayed at replay-proxy. We need to check idempotency and ledger dedup.
jana_eng: Can you run this to map request footprints -> ledger entries?
```
SELECT r.request_id, r.started_at, r.payload_sha256, u.ledger_id, u.tokens
FROM requests r
LEFT JOIN usage u ON u.request_id = r.request_id
WHERE r.customer_id = 'acme' AND r.started_at BETWEEN '2026-12-01 08:11:50' AND '2026-12-01 08:13:00';
```
kevin_billing: Ran it — found 3 distinct request_ids with same payload_sha256 and each had separate usage rows: req_01 (40_150 tokens), req_02 (40_150 tokens), req_03 (40_150 tokens).
maria_support: So ledger shows 3 separate charges. How did gateway accept retries as independent?
jana_eng: Two hypotheses: (1) client retried after 504 and our gateway also retried upstream without checking Idempotency-Key, causing 3 total attempts (client retry + gateway retry + final success). (2) Replay service replayed an initial failure. We need to trace the path.
kevin_billing: For remediation, we can issue a one-off credit to Anna while eng investigates. Impact: 360k tokens -> crediting 240_750 tokens (for duplicates).
anna_acme: Appreciate the quick help. We need root cause and mitigation.
jana_eng: Agreed. For root cause, engineering will: 1) add stronger dedup in ingress: if payload_sha256 matches a recent completed request for same customer within X minutes, mark duplicate and attach original request_id to usage row instead of creating new ledger entry; 2) ensure gateway retry logic preserves Idempotency-Key header and does not perform extra upstream retries when client is retrying; 3) add observability: a "duplicate-detected" metric and tag ledger entries with request_fingerprint.
maria_support: Timeline for the hotfix?
jana_eng: Patch for ledger dedup + metric in 48h, gateway config change to stop double-retries in 24h. Will also add an immediate alert to ops for similar spikes.
kevin_billing: I'll create a billing ticket and issue a provisional credit. Will need a signed confirmation from Anna to finalize.
maria_support: I'll coordinate with Anna and close loop. Also adding this thread link to the escalation doc.
sre-bot: Incident created INC-2026-1221, assigned to eng-infra, priority=P2.
kevin_billing: Note for postmortem: add a test case for client+gateway+ingress combos to assert idempotency.
jana_eng: one more: we should reflect dedup policy in docs to recommend clients set Idempotency-Key on long-running batch requests.
anna_acme: thanks all. keeping client on hold until credit processed.
maria_support: follow-ups: (1) credit processed (provisional) by billing, (2) eng will ship dedup metric in 48h, (3) I'll update customer after final credit. :white_check_mark:
